data.revised_prompt: Create an image in a flat vector art style showing a scene from history. The setting is the vast expanse of the Australian outback desert as colored in muted earth tones - olive green, brown, dusty yellow. You see a massive emu bird, known for its speed, sprinting across this harsh landscape with dust flying everywhere. Behind the bird, emanating the chase and intensifying the action, is a 1930s military truck trying to keep up. This visual narration portrays motion and speed vividly. Compose this action-filled scenario in a cinematic composition with a 9:16 vertical format.
